name: Las Alcobas Mexico City
positioning: Owner-managed Luxury Collection hotel on Masaryk in Polanco, with Yabu Pushelberg rosewood interiors and Aurora Spa
best_for: Travelers who want a Polanco base near luxury shopping and Chapultepec Park
Guests who value refined rooms and in-room bath rituals

facts.text: The hotel sits on Masaryk, a high-end street in the Polanco district of Mexico City.
All rooms have contemporary designs and custom rosewood furniture by Yabu Pushelberg.
Every room and suite has Rivolta Carmignani linens imported from Italy.
Rooms have marble bathrooms with rain showers.
The in-room minibar includes complimentary soft drinks and Mexican candies, refilled daily.
The Presidential Pasaje penthouse suite has a fireplace and a terrace.
The building was once an apartment block bought by owner Samuel Leizorek.
The name Las Alcobas means the alcoves.
Chapultepec Park lies to the south of the Polanco neighborhood.
The hotel is close to luxury shopping and the Soumaya Museum.
Anatol, led by chef Rodrigo Del Valle, has a menu inspired by farm-to-table ingredients.
Complimentary breakfast is available to hotel guests during their stay.

highlights.text: Guests can book an in-room aromatherapy bath service, choosing from homemade herbal blends.
A central spiral staircase with plush carpeting is the centerpiece of the common area.
Aurora Spa combines Mexico City's energy with the region's indigenous ingredients and age-old healing techniques.
Corner Panoramic rooms have curved floor-to-ceiling windows.
It is one of the few luxury hotels in the Luxury Collection that remains owner-managed.

considerations.text: The spa is small, with two treatment rooms on the second floor.
WhataHotel notes limited on-site recreational facilities.
